The following particles are used to describe the structure of an atom.
electron neutron proton quark

The following equation represents the decay of a nucleus of cobalt-60 to form nucleus Q by β⁻ emission.

$^{60}_{27}\mathrm{Co} \rightarrow {}^{A}_{B}\mathrm{Q} + \beta^- + x$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
